articles.headline: Ghana's players are fully on board with 'father' Carlos Queiroz and his defensive style
articles.description: Ghana are one of only four teams -- along with Mexico, Argentina and Spain -- not to concede in their two opening World Cup games, despite facing 30 shots across their matches and using two goalkeepers.

articles.headline: Ronwen Williams pays tribute to past Bafana greats after South Korea win
articles.description: Ronwen Williams said that although he was the first captain of a Bafana team which made the World Cup knockout rounds, past icons paved the way.

articles.headline: Aubrey Modiba: Canada must beware of Bafana 'upset' despite 'home' advantage
articles.description: South Africa's Aubrey Modiba is quietly confident that Bafana Bafana can add to the World Cup's growing list of surprise results when they face Canada in their Last 32 match in Inglewood on Sunday.

articles.headline: Black Stars wearing 'Atletico Ghana' tag as a badge of honour as World Cup knockouts beckon

articles.headline: South Africa vs. Canada - Kick-off time, team news, how to watch World Cup round of 32 clash
articles.description: Bafana Bafana will face Canada in their first ever FIFA World Cup knockout game on Sunday in Los Angeles, and Themba Zwane remains suspended.

articles.headline: World Cup: Grades for every eliminated team, as they exit the tournament
articles.description: When the World Cup ends, 47 teams will have been eliminated, and we're grading every one on how their run compared with expectations.
